meta.title: perf: Performance analysis for default channel migration
meta.body_summary: Performance analysis document for PR #1107, identifying inefficiencies in the default channel migration (row-by-row processing, subqueries, sequential operations) and recommending set-based migration, JOINs, batching, and indexes.

perf_labels.notes: Devin performed a performance analysis document for a migration PR; no human review occurred, bot auto-closed after inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 154 changed lines in a single file, this is a small documentation addition, not code. As a performance analysis advisory, it was closed without merge due to no maintainer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No human review or comment; PR auto-closed by Devin bot after 7+ days of inactivity.
review_details.performance_claim: The analysis identifies performance anti-patterns in migration script, Channel API, and UI operations, with recommendations for set-based migration, JOINs, batching, and indexes.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: repeated_io, nested_loop, sequential_blocking_ops (prior patterns in PR #1107)
review_details.rejection_signals: Devin bot auto-closed PR after 7+ days inactivity with no human review or engagement.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin provided a standalone performance analysis document without being integrated into the target codebase; no maintainer acted on it, leading to stale closure. This demonstrates a process boundary where unsolicited advisory PRs may not receive review unless aligned with maintainer priorities.
